text: 金十数据8月11日讯，上海市经济和信息化委员会印发《上海市软件和信息服务业发展“十五五”规划》。其中提到，形成“大集群+小集群+边缘算力”协同的梯次供给体系，在松江、临港、青浦等布局打造十万卡级超大规模智算集群，在宝山、浦东、嘉定等布局建设千卡级智算集群。引导传统数据中心、信息通信机房向百卡级边缘智算中心转变，满足企业、个人超低时延算力需求。聚焦金融、教育、医疗、文旅、工业等行业建设模型即服务（MaaS）平台，提供行业应用广场、模型定制与托管、Agent搭建、低代码开发、API接口、算力提供与管理、AI推理等服务应用，提升智算云服务能级。
text_en: Jin Shi Data August 11 - The Shanghai Municipal Commission of Economy and Informatization issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Shanghai's Software and Information Services Industry.' It mentions forming a tiered supply system with 'large clusters + small clusters + edge computing power' collaboration, deploying 100,000-card-scale ultra-large intelligent computing clusters in Songjiang, Lingang, Qingpu, etc., and building thousand-card-scale intelligent computing clusters in Baoshan, Pudong, Jiading, etc. It guides traditional data centers and information communication rooms to transform into hundred-card-scale edge intelligent computing centers to meet ultra-low-latency computing needs for enterprises and individuals. It focuses on building Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) platforms for finance, education, healthcare, culture and tourism, industry, etc., providing services such as industry application plazas, model customization and hosting, Agent building, low-code development, API interfaces, computing power provision and management, and AI inference, to enhance intelligent computing cloud service capabilities.
